name: agent-sdk-harness
description: Claude Code harness for building agent-sdk agents. /new-agent scaffolds a template repo; /add-tool and /add-source wire extension points; /agent-verify runs conformance and OAuth-chain probes; /scenario generates JTBD usage scenarios into workspace/scenarios/; /codify captures learnings into workspace/learning/; /analyze creates and audits PRD/ADR docs in workspace/; the sdk-advisor agent reasons about SDK conventions and invariants. Reuses the agent-interop check kit (agent-stack-check + a2a/a2ui/ag-ui/mcp advisors).
